title: The Wemmace.
description: This texture pack replaces the normal mace texture with Wemmbu... as a mace..?? Design by @asthenea on TikTok, go support them!
body:
### Wemmbu... As a mace??

_Yup_ that's right, this texture pack does exactly that! You can now murder other people with a Wemmbu mace, or as I like to call it, Wemmace!

Original design by `@asthenea` on TikTok, go support them!

![Me holding an enchanted Wemmace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Pd06Vmx4/images/ef562d21ed68eaf63656edea06388f5e9a53c7ca.png)
